**Notes:** 🔑 THE THIRD INSTANCE OF ONE DISCRIMINATOR IN THIS CAMPAIGN, and it is consistent all three times. This codebase defaults CLOSED where a flag gates an action and OPEN where it gates a suggestion, and each site states which it is: the screen-share opt-in fails off because it gates capture; the fingerprint switch fails on because it only proposes; and this store fails open because suppressing a suggestion is the thing being lost. The cost of the wrong direction is what decides it — an unwanted chip versus a silently disabled feature — rather than a blanket rule.
